newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady after futures rebound.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady after futures rebound.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady to slightly higher on Wednesday after a rebound in crude and gasoline futures, traders said.
Eurograde barges were last heard at $210/$213 fob ARA and regular unleaded at $205/$207 fob ARA.
Elf Aquitaine said an accident ripped the top off a storage tank at its Donges refinery in western France on Wednesday, spreading fumes and disrupting rail traffic.
But production at the 210,000 barrels per day plant was not affected since most of the it had already been shut earlier this week for routine maintenance.
